title: nf-global-arithmetic
objective: Implement exact embeddings/signatures, roots of unity, bounded certified units, regulators, class groups, and class-number formula internals.

handoff.summary: Adds exact all-degree signatures and deterministic embedding order, certified roots-of-unity slices, replay-certified full real-quadratic units, explicit incomplete higher-rank unit searches, exact QQ and imaginary-quadratic class groups, and a proof-status-aware binary64 class-number-formula report.
risks: QQbar numerical approximation currently discards Arb radii, so embeddings and regulators are explicitly non-rigorous binary64 approximations.
Nonquadratic unit saturation and class groups remain incomplete until prime-ideal factorization, ideal inversion/reduction, principality witnesses, LLL/enumeration, and enclosure transports land.
Imaginary-quadratic class groups have exact reduced-form enumeration evidence but do not claim general ideal-product principal-element witnesses.
next_steps: Integration should add thin lazy public NumberField methods and strict/precompile manifests.
After the prime-ideal lane lands, add Minkowski prime generation, exact principality witnesses, and a complete bounded nonquadratic class-group slice.
Add Arb enclosure transport before advertising rigorous embedding matrices or regulators above binary64.
